text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - With 100 days to go before Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule, major cities arond China celebrate the beginning of the final countdown.
- More Chinese listed firms pay attention to capital management by acquiring shares in other companies.
- State enterprises still account for more than half of China's industrial tax income despite their problems.
- BUSINESS NEWS - In the past 18 years of reform, China has opened nearly all sectors to foreign investment, with the exception of those connected with state security and journalism.
- The State Administration of Foreign Exchange is considering setting limits on foreign exchange borrowing by financial institutions.
